editorialSummary.heading: Early dismissals, weather make-up days and graduation
paragraphs: September 23, 2026 is an early-dismissal day, not a day off. Elementary schools have parent conferences, while middle and high schools have professional learning. October 16 is another shortened school day and marks the end of Quarter 1. The district lists seven early-dismissal dates in all. Elementary students are scheduled to leave at 1:35 p.m.; Lecanto Middle, the Academy of Environmental Science and CREST have their own published dismissal times.

Citrus County has a specific order for making up instructional time lost to hurricanes or tornadoes. The district would first extend the September 23, October 16, October 28 and November 18 early dismissals to full school days. November 23-25 would come next, followed by December 21-22. Those five weekdays are holidays on the published calendar, not confirmed make-up school days. Families planning trips around Thanksgiving or Christmas should check district notices for changes.

The Christmas holiday runs December 19, 2026 through January 3, 2027. Students also have January 4-5 off for teacher workdays and January 6 off for professional learning, with classes resuming January 7. Spring break is March 20-28, followed by the separate Easter Monday holiday on March 29. Students are scheduled to return Tuesday, March 30.

Graduating seniors have their last day of school on May 21, 2027, while other students finish May 27. Graduation ceremonies are scheduled for CREST on May 20, Withlacoochee Technical College on May 24, Crystal River High on May 25, Citrus High on May 26 and Lecanto High on May 27. The district calendar does not give ceremony times or venues. WTC follows its own attendance calendar.

about.dataSource: The supplied one-page PDF is byte-for-byte identical to the current official download and prints School Board approval December 9, 2025. The district calendar page repeats the annual dates. Additional official sources supply current school hours, the October 8 weather notice, Citrus eSchool calendar scope and WTC’s separate schedule.
about.processing: Extracted and visually inspected the complete PDF, including the colored legend and diagonal early-dismissal symbols. Seven dates have student early dismissal; September 23 conferences and October 16 teacher work do not turn those dates into full closures. Combined October 16 and May 27 facts are each one canonical event. Only November 23-25 and December 21-22 are conditional holiday dates, split from confirmed holiday portions. Their source ranges are explicit in the make-up order; the remaining fragments are derived subdivisions of official holiday ranges. December and January Christmas entries remain separate events. The winter planning span adds January 4-5 workdays and January 6 professional learning without renaming them Christmas holidays. Spring break plus Easter Monday is a derived continuous span, with a derived March 30 return. The regular non-senior date grid has 209 weekdays, 24 confirmed no-class weekdays and five conditional holiday weekdays, yielding 180 scheduled attendance days; no official annual total is printed. School hours were verified from the official page’s detailed accessible image text; the separate PNG fetch failed. No unpublished effective dates are inferred. Pre-year staff days, July 4, the May 28 staff workday and post-year Memorial Day are omitted. Graduation milestones do not close other students’ classes; the May 21 senior endpoint does not narrow the district May 27 event.
about.updates: Checked the current calendar page, matching PDF, district homepage and full October 8 weather notice on October 16, 2026. That notice keeps schools open October 9 with normal schedules while changing some extracurricular activities; no districtwide closure or later make-up activation was verified. The current school-hours page and WTC and eSchool scope sources were also reviewed.
about.disclaimer: Holiday reserve dates remain scheduled off unless the district activates make-up arrangements. The first four early dismissals may instead become full days. Confirm school notices before arranging pickup or travel. Graduation times and venues are not supplied by this annual PDF, and WTC students need the college’s separate attendance calendar.

faqs.question: When is the first and last day of school in Citrus County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students start Monday, August 10, 2026. The last day for most students is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Graduating seniors finish earlier, on Friday, May 21.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Citrus County seniors?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 21, 2027 is the last day for graduating seniors. Other students finish May 27. Graduation ceremonies are scheduled separately by school, so seniors should follow their school's instructions for exams, checkout and graduation.

faqs.question: What are the early-dismissal dates for Citrus County Schools in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The seven dates on the approved calendar are September 23, October 16, October 28 and November 18, 2026, plus February 24, March 17 and April 21, 2027. These are student attendance days with early dismissal. The four fall dates are also listed in the district's hurricane/tornado make-up plan, so families should check official notices for any schedule changes.

faqs.question: What time do Citrus County elementary schools dismiss early?
faqs.answer: The district's published elementary school hours are 9:20 a.m. to 3:35 p.m. on regular days and 9:20 a.m. to 1:35 p.m. on early-dismissal days. Times are Eastern. Check school notices for any changes.

faqs.question: What time do Citrus County middle schools dismiss early?
faqs.answer: Most district middle schools run from 7:50 a.m. to 2:20 p.m. and dismiss at 12:20 p.m. on early-dismissal days. Lecanto Middle School follows a different schedule. All times are Eastern.

faqs.question: What are Lecanto Middle School's regular and early-dismissal hours?
faqs.answer: Lecanto Middle School runs from 7:55 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. on regular days. On scheduled early-dismissal days, students leave at 12:30 p.m. These times differ from the district's other middle schools.

faqs.question: What time do Citrus County high schools dismiss early?
faqs.answer: The district's standard high school schedule is 7:45 a.m. to 2:42 p.m., with early dismissal at 12:42 p.m. The Academy of Environmental Science and CREST have separate schedules. All times are Eastern.

faqs.question: What are the early-dismissal hours for the Academy of Environmental Science?
faqs.answer: The Academy of Environmental Science (AES) runs from 7:55 a.m. to 2:02 p.m. on regular days. Students dismiss at 12:02 p.m. on scheduled early-dismissal days, according to the district's published school-hours table.

faqs.question: What time does CREST School dismiss on early-release days?
faqs.answer: CREST School runs from 8:45 a.m. to 3:15 p.m. on regular days and dismisses at 1:15 p.m. on scheduled early-dismissal days. These times are different from the district's standard elementary, middle and high school schedules.

faqs.question: Is September 23, 2026 a day off for Citrus County students?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, September 23 is an early-dismissal school day. Elementary schools have parent conferences, while middle and high schools have professional learning. Students attend classes before leaving early. Contact the elementary school for conference appointment details.

faqs.question: Is October 16, 2026 a full student holiday?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, October 16 is an early-dismissal school day and the end of Quarter 1. Although the calendar also mentions a teacher workday, students are scheduled to attend and leave early rather than take the entire day off.

faqs.question: Does Citrus County Schools have a fall break in October 2026?
faqs.answer: The approved 2026-2027 district calendar does not list a separate October fall break. October 16 and October 28 are scheduled early-dismissal school days, not full days off. The next multi-day holiday is Thanksgiving break, November 21-29, with November 23-25 reserved for possible weather make-up.

faqs.question: Are Citrus County schools closed for Veterans Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wednesday, November 11, 2026 is a school holiday for Veterans Day. Students do not have classes.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Citrus County Schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: The approved calendar lists Thanksgiving break from Saturday, November 21 through Sunday, November 29, 2026. Students are scheduled to return Monday, November 30. However, November 23-25 may be used as weather make-up days if the district announces a change.

faqs.question: Will Citrus County students have school November 23-25, 2026?
faqs.answer: November 23-25 are scheduled as part of Thanksgiving break, not regular school days. However, they are second in the district's hurricane/tornado make-up order, after the four fall early dismissals. Families should check current district notices before treating all three days as guaranteed time off.

faqs.question: Is December 18, 2026 an early-dismissal day?
faqs.answer: No. December 18 marks the end of Quarter 2, but the approved calendar does not list an early dismissal that day. The published Christmas holiday begins December 19.

faqs.question: When is Christmas break, and when do Citrus County students return?
faqs.answer: Christmas break is December 19, 2026 through January 3, 2027. January 4-5 are teacher workdays, and January 6 is professional learning, so students return Thursday, January 7. December 21-22 could become weather make-up days if the district activates them.

faqs.question: Could Citrus County students have school December 21 or 22, 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, but only if the district uses those dates for weather make-up. December 21-22 are scheduled holidays and the third priority in the published make-up order, after the fall early-dismissal extensions and November 23-25. Check district announcements for any change.

faqs.question: Do Citrus County students have school January 4-6, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. January 4 and 5 are teacher workdays, and January 6 is a professional learning day. Students are scheduled to return January 7. These staff days follow the Christmas holiday rather than being part of its officially named date range.

faqs.question: Which single-day holidays are on the Citrus County school calendar?
faqs.answer: During the regular 2026-2027 student school year, the district lists Labor Day on September 7, Veterans Day on November 11, Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, Presidents Day on February 15 and Easter Monday on March 29. These are student holidays. Teacher workdays and professional learning days are separate no-class dates.

faqs.question: When is spring break for Citrus County Schools in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 20-28, 2027. Students also have Monday, March 29 off for the separate Easter Monday holiday, making Tuesday, March 30 the scheduled return to school.

faqs.question: Do Citrus County students have school on Good Friday, March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, March 26 falls within the district's scheduled March 20-28 spring break. The calendar does not list Good Friday as a separate holiday.

faqs.question: Are Citrus County schools closed on Easter Monday in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, March 29, 2027 is a school holiday for Easter Monday. It comes immediately after spring break, and students are scheduled to return Tuesday, March 30.

faqs.question: Do Citrus County students have school on April 16, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, April 16 is a teacher workday with no student classes. Students are scheduled to return Monday, April 19. Unlike October 16, this is a full nonstudent day rather than an early-dismissal day.

faqs.question: How does Citrus County Schools make up hurricane or tornado days?
faqs.answer: The approved calendar gives three priorities. First, September 23, October 16, October 28 and November 18 may be extended from early dismissals to full school days. Second, the district may use November 23-25. Third, it may use December 21-22. These are possible arrangements, not automatic schedule changes. Check current district announcements.

faqs.question: When do the four grading quarters end in Citrus County Schools?
faqs.answer: Quarter 1 ends October 16, 2026; Quarter 2 ends December 18; Quarter 3 ends March 12, 2027; and Quarter 4 ends May 27. October 16 is also an early-dismissal day. The calendar does not identify the other three quarter-end dates as early dismissals.

faqs.question: When are Citrus County school report cards released?
faqs.answer: The district's Student Progression Plan says elementary and middle school report cards are issued after each quarter, while high school and Citrus eSchool report cards follow each semester. The 2026-2027 calendar lists quarter-end dates but does not specify exact report-card posting dates. Families should check Focus and school communications for release information.

faqs.question: Is May 27, 2027 an early-dismissal day in Citrus County?
faqs.answer: No. Thursday, May 27 is the last scheduled student day and the end of Quarter 4, but the approved calendar does not mark it for early dismissal. Lecanto High School graduation is also listed for that date.

faqs.question: When are the 2027 Citrus County school graduation ceremonies?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists CREST graduation on May 20, Withlacoochee Technical College on May 24, Crystal River High School on May 25, Citrus High School on May 26 and Lecanto High School on May 27, 2027. Graduating seniors have their last school day on May 21.

faqs.question: What time and where are Citrus County's 2027 graduation ceremonies?
faqs.answer: The approved district calendar lists graduation dates for CREST, Withlacoochee Technical College, Crystal River High, Citrus High and Lecanto High, but it does not provide ceremony times or venues. Check the graduating school's announcements for confirmed details.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are in the 2026-2027 Citrus County calendar?
faqs.answer: The regular calendar works out to 180 scheduled attendance weekdays: 209 weekdays from August 10 through May 27, minus 24 confirmed nonstudent weekdays and five holiday weekdays reserved for possible weather make-up. This is a calculation, not an annual total published in the official PDF. It does not apply to seniors' shorter year or WTC's separate calendar, and make-up changes could affect it.

faqs.question: Does Citrus eSchool follow the same calendar as Citrus County public schools?
faqs.answer: Yes. The district's 2026-2027 Student Code of Conduct states that Citrus eSchool follows the same calendar as brick-and-mortar schools. Virtual attendance is based on coursework progress, so online students should follow their program's daily work and teacher-contact instructions rather than campus bell times.

faqs.question: Does Withlacoochee Technical College follow the Citrus County K-12 calendar?
faqs.answer: No. Withlacoochee Technical College (WTC) publishes a separate attendance calendar. Its 2026-2027 calendar lists August 6 as the first day for WTC students and August 10 for dual-enrolled students. Use WTC's own calendar for classes and planning. Its May 24 graduation also appears on the district calendar.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official Citrus County school calendar PDF for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The approved 2026-2027 calendar PDF is linked from the Citrus County Schools calendar page at https://www.citrusschools.org/330106_2. The document shows School Board approval dated December 9, 2025. Check the district's official updates and school notices for any later schedule changes.
